title: Monoidal structures arising from $B_\infty$-algebras with applications to Hopf algebras
summary: We give an explicit construction of monoidal structures on derived categories of right $A_\infty$-modules over an $A_\infty$-algebra $A$ equipped with a $B_\infty$-structure. Given such a $B_\infty$-algebra $A$, we construct an induction functor \[ι\colon \mathcal{D}^{\rm{r}}_\infty(A) \longrightarrow \mathcal{D}^{\rm{bi}}_\infty(A)\] from right $A_\infty$-modules to $A_\infty$-bimodules and define \[M\boxtimes_A N=M\overset{\infty}{\otimes}_Aι(N).\] We prove that $(\mathcal{D}^{\rm{r}}_\infty(A),\boxtimes_A,A)$ is a monoidal triangulated category: the unit and associativity constraints are…
